asyncCancellationTests.reason: This Issue adds only immutable values and pure static functions. There is no task, clock, timer, buffer, connection, pasteboard handle, or other owned resource, so there is nothing to cancel or clean up. A cancel test would have required inventing an async wrapper solely to have something to cancel, which would add untested public API and prove nothing. Purity and the absence of owned resources are asserted directly by codecIsPureAcrossRepeatedSuccessAndFailure instead.
